AniLife mobile performance polish — corrected Kotlin type mismatch and all existing features preserved
Source feature revision: e844a631ad2fc08f9cccdbafd0430a3498d23c5a
The previous preview build exposed a Kotlin compile error in the new memoized Home drag row map: it inferred Map<String,HomeRow>, while rememberHomeRowDragState expects Map<Any,HomeRow>. The map is now explicitly constructed as buildMap<Any,HomeRow>; keys and values are unchanged.
Performance only: PixelCopy bitmap creation and getPixels off main, cancellation-safe cleanup; precomputed unchanged Morphe row alpha; Home item and hero caching; Watch episode filter and grid caching.
Leave Media3 playback engine and video surface, Morphe frame sampling rate/color render, gestures, seek, subtitle/audio tracks, downloads, watchlist, profiles, app id, settings and all finished UI untouched.
Run :app:testMobileDebugUnitTest, :app:lintMobileDebug, :app:assembleMobileDebug, verify signature and publish glass-ui-preview only on full success. Previous published release remains intact until success.
